Seasonal Effects for the Farplains
Humbled By The Horizon
The winds speak in these lands, rising from a gentle soothing breeze that caresses the grass and carries the heady scent of vitality, to an 
overwhelming tempest, darkening the skies menacingly and pulling trees from their roots. Like no other, this is a landscape of herds, 
constantly migrating to feast on the blossoming fields, leaving churned earth and the bodies of their weak in the their wake.
The Farplains span much of the island, and the great dividing mountain range of the Splitspine mountain account for much of its 
diverse environments. In the west, the arid Grayfynn with its argustaur sentinels and thorned succulents, to the central plateau of the 
Tundrus highlands, supporting little on its cold soil but lichens and quick-footed draffers. And lastly, thanks to the mountain's rain 
shadow, the east enjoys a bountiful flowering gardens found in the Valedayn with their lumbering bloomux and other large arthropods.

Seasonal Weather Effects
A Sunless Sky
Maedrynn flock in great 
murmurs, becoming the 
region’s Apex Predator during 
Spring. Encounters with its 
murmurs are frequent. They 
can use the Calling Cries 
during this season.
Raiding Axilot
Axilot race across the roaming 
herds during the height of 
summer. Double any found 
on the Expedition Hunt and 
Scavenger Tables and they gain 
Advantage to Initiative rolls.
Raiding Axilot
Fearing the voracious 
murmurs of maedrynn, 
tyrandroth stay safe in the 
Wealdwoods. Re-roll the first 
of any Hunting Expeditions or 
Scavenger rolls that result in a 
tyrandroth.
Brazen Skies
The heat stirs the blood of the 
hunting grahknash during 
summer, they have Advantage 
on Strength rolls and have 
Advantage on Instinct rolls.
Dry Desperation
A lack of fresh eggs to sate the 
hectatrex diet leads it to raid the 
young of the herds. They gain 
the Skill - Stealth +6.
Preparing for Winter
Preparing to feast before 
the colder season, khanith 
stalk far more actively. They 
gain Advantage on Dexterity 
(Stealth) checks. 
Cold Blooded Lethargy 
A frigid cold grips the fields, 
bloomux, drafian, khanith, 
khanaur, rutort and tyrandroth 
all have Disadvantage on 
Initiative rolls.
Blooming Fields
Bloomux drink deep from 
the blossoming flowers, their 
Fatal Burst Action becomes 
30 ft. centered on the dying 
bloomux.
Gatherer’s Moon 
Gathering stores of nuts before 
the colder season, khanaur 
feast with abandon. They gain 
Disadvantage on Initiative 
rolls but gain +2 AC during this 
season.
Dominating Tundra
Draffers, adapted to the colder 
climes can chase down prey 
with ease on the snow covered 
ground. They gain 10 ft. to their 
movement speed.
Shelter from the Cold
Female Omaterssum listen 
keenly for the call of wayward 
infants on the cold fields and 
find many adoptive young 
during this season. Change 
their Adoptive Litter roll to 2d4 
instead of 1d4 if encountered in 
the Farplains.
Silken Threat
Drafian are found migrating 
across the fields, leaving 5 ft. 
wide Silken Streams. While the 
thin, nearly translucent strands 
can be difficult to see, the sun 
catches them brilliantly. DC 16 
Wisdom (Perception) check. 
Failure: The Traveler comes in 
contact with the thread and 
suffers 1d6 Poison damage.

Glaring Brightness • Creatures suffer Disadvantage on 
Wisdom (Perception) checks involving sight during the 
day.
Clear Skies • Calm weather with no effects.
Rain • -2 to Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight 
beyond 30 ft.. All Fire damage rolls have a –1 damage 
penalty.
Drizzle • -1 to Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on 
sight beyond 60 ft..
Billowing Winds • Roll a 1d4 for the wind direction once 
per day, 1d4 Result: 1: East 2: West 3: South 4: North.
Flying creatures gain +10 ft. movement speed when 
moving with the wind, and –10 ft. movement speed when 
moving against it. All Ranged weapon attacks have a –2 
penalty to attack rolls, and their Range is reduced by half 
when shooting against the wind.
Fertile Winds • The wind carries all manner of scents 
and pollen from afar. Creatures gain +1 to Perception 
(Wisdom) checks that rely on smell.
Heavy Rain • -2 to Perception (Wisdom) checks that rely 
on sight beyond 30 ft..  All Fire damage rolls have a –3 
damage penalty. All Cold damage rolls gain an additional 
+2  damage. Negate the benefits of a Long Rest if 
attempted without any cover or protection from the rain.
Maedrynn Scouring • Bones are found lying across vast 
swaths of the landscape after the passing of a maedrynn 
murmur. Re-roll any Creature results from Hunting 
Expeditions, the Traveler must keep the second result. 
Ooradew Affluence • Ooradew is found glistening in 
abundance on grassy fields. Any Foraging Expeditions 
will yield double the result for Ooradew. As it saturates 
the fields, any Short Rests on the Farplains adds an 
additional 1d6 to the total healed from resting. 
Blazing Heat • Any creature not native to the Farplains, 
exposed to the day’s extreme heat without access to 
drinkable water: DC 5 Constitution Saving Throw each 
hour, which rises 5 for each additional hour exposed. 
Failure: Suffer 1 level of Exhaustion. Creatures that have 
Resistance or Immunity to Fire damage automatically 
succeed on the save.

Convincing Mirages • Visions of oases and far off locations 
waver in the distance. When seen, DC 12 Intelligence 
(Investigation) or Wisdom (Perception) check. Success: 
The Traveler understands it is false. 
Summer's Spice • The sweet and spicy peppers thrive in 
the heat of the summer sun. Any Foraging Expeditions 
will yield double the result for Ilyrana Peppers.

Cleansing Flames • Flint reeds expose their silvery fibers 
during the fall, rubbing abrasively from the wind or 
traversing Travelers may spark a flame. This Plant-Trap 
will be encountered more frequently.
Sky’s Fury • A tumultuous heat storm breaks overhead. 
Roll a d20 every 1 hour when outside without shelter for 
every Traveler in the party. On a 1, they are struck by a 
lightning dealing 2d12 Lightning damage. 
Storms of Dust • Dry soil and windblown leaves make 
it difficult to track and see on the Farplains. Creatures 
not native to the biome suffer Disadvantage on Tracking 
Wisdom (Survival) checks.
Ripe Harvest • Orange leaves rise from conical hard-
rind fruit, announcing their ripeness. Any Foraging 
Expeditions will yield double the result for Spunmelon.
Screaming Heat • Shrillion plants grow thick and ready 
to release their trapped gases. This Natural-Trap will be 
encountered more frequently.

Chilling Skies • Any creature not native to the Farplains, 
exposed to the season’s extreme cold without access to 
fire or a heat source: DC 5 Constitution Saving Throw 
each hour, which rises 5 for each additional hour exposed. 
Failure: Suffer 1 level of Exhaustion. Creatures that have 
Resistance or Immunity to Cold damage automatically 
succeed on the save. 
Steps in the Snow • Wisdom (Survival) checks related to 
Tracking are made with Advantage thanks to the ease of 
snow drifts covering the Farplains.
The Last Harvest • With leaves nestled safely in a wooden 
shell, bloomstone rises to take advantage of the lack of 
plants competing for space to soak in the weaker winter 
sunlight. Any Foraging Expeditions will yield double the 
result for Bloomstone.

Feverish Beauty • Deliris yarrow plants rise from the 
fields, causing a strange behavior in nearby fauna. This 
Natural-Trap will be encountered more frequently.
Ice Trapped Fish • ±1 to the Range Result on a Fishing 
Expedition Roll.
